title: Choosing Violence: The Skin Graph & Gnarl Weekend Tour
original_title: Choosing Violence: The Skin Graph & Gnarl Weekend Tour
overview: Skin Graph is a powerviolence band currently split between Tupelo and Starkville while Gnarl is a project from Starkville that can only be described as a violent form of drone metal, and in January of 2026, two bands set out on a short weekend tour through the scenes of deepest of the deep south.
